heading: IND-W vs BAN-W Highlights: India thump Bangladesh by 114 runs to reach Asian Games final, play Sri Lanka next for gold
paragraphs:
IND-W vs BAN-W Highlights: Thumping 114-run win for India in the semifinal. They play Sri Lanka in the final on Tuesday. The win was totally set up by Shafali Verma's maiden T20I ton, 100 not off 49 balls. India made 195/4 and Bangladesh were never in the chase and folded for 81 with Deepti Sharma picking up three wickets. Nandani Sharma also picked up three with two off successive balls.

Off the last ball of the innings, Shafali Verma reached her maiden T20I century off just 49 balls. She hit three fours and nine sixes. India finished on 195/4. India captain Harmanpreet Kaur also played a nice hand of 40 off 33 balls. During the course of her innings, Shafali set a new record. She has now hit maximum sixes for India in T20Is. Smriti Mandhana, during her 37, also became the highest run-getter in women's T20Is, going past Suzie Bates (4,758).

India captain Harmanpreet Kaur has won the toss and decided to bat first against Bangladesh. The Indian team is unchanged from their last game against hosts Japan. The winners of the contest will face Sri Lanka in the final who earlier today beat Pakistan.

India will look to move one step closer to retaining their Asian Games women’s cricket gold medal when they face Bangladesh in the semi-final at Korogi Sports Park in Nisshin on Sunday. Harmanpreet Kaur’s side entered the last four after a commanding eight-wicket victory over hosts Japan in the quarter-final. India’s clinical performance underlined the depth and experience in their squad, with their established stars expected to once again lead the charge in the knockout stage.

Bangladesh, meanwhile, reached the semi-finals without taking the field in their quarter-final. Their clash against China was abandoned because of rain, with Bangladesh progressing on the basis of their higher seeding. That leaves them facing a major test against an Indian side that has enjoyed considerable success in recent T20 cricket.

India’s batting will once again be central to their hopes, with Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma and Harmanpreet among the key names in a powerful top order. Deepti Sharma also adds considerable value with both bat and ball, while India have several options in their bowling attack. For Bangladesh, captain Nigar Sultana and their experienced core will need to produce a disciplined performance if they are to disrupt India’s rhythm.

IND-W vs BAN-W Highlights: Chasing 196 to win, the Bangladeshis were bowled out for 81 in the 16th over. Deepti Sharma and Nandani Sharma picked up three wickets each. Shree Charani took two. Kranti Gaud and Shreyanka Patil were the other wicket-takers. India now play Sri Lanka in the final on Tuesday. Let's not forget Shafali Verma's maiden T20I ton set up this victory. Her 100 not out off 49 balls was simply breathtaking. She hit nine sixes during the course of her innings.
IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: It's all over bar the shouting. One more wicket goes down. Deepti Sharma traps the batter lbw. Marufa Akter goes for 5. 81/9 now

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Supta goes for 10. After landing, the ball spun away a bit. Supta was totally beaten and Richa Ghosh did the rest behind the wicket. Bangladesh 8 wickets down with just 66 on the board. Second wicket for Shree Charani. In the previous match, she had taken 4/10.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Nandini Sharma bowls a cutter and Nahida Akter fails to read it. Lobs it and Nandini dives full length on her right to complete a brilliant catch. Here is another wicket for Nandani. Cleans up Rebiya Khan. Seven wickets down for Bangladesh. Hat-trick chance. A dot. Bangladesh 56/7 after 11 overs.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Off her just second ball. Half the side is back in the dugout. It's Dilara Akter out for 27. Simple catch for Shreyanka Patil at mid-off. Dilara played well during her short innings. Surely it's match over for Bangladesh. Remember, the winners of this match will play Sri Lanka in the final who beat Pakistan earlier today. B'desh 53/5 after 10. Nahida Akter picked up a boundary on the legside. A rare fulltoss from Deepti
IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Shorna Akter goes for 5. Harmanpreet takes the catch at mid-off. Not exactly a convincing catch but all's well that ends well. Bangladesh 43/4 after seven overs.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: For 9. Shree Charani accounts for her as Kranti Gaud takes a nice catch at mid-on. Nigar Sultana goes for a big shot but there is no real connection. Shorna Akter is the new batter. Bangladesh 39/3 after six overs. India were 72/1 at this stage. Bangladesh already much behind.
IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: For Dilara Akter. One on the offside, one on the leg. Kranti Gaud concedes 15. Nigar Sultana also picked up a boundary. Bangladesh 34/2 after five overs.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Dilara Akter takes 10 runs off the Nandani Sharma over. She picks up a four and a six. Bangladesh 19/2 after four overs. That six over long-off was simply breathtaking. The pitch continues to play good.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Sobhana Mostary goes for 4. Nice catch from Bharti Fulmali. Kranti Gaud takes her first wicket. Mostary went for a pull shot but couldn't execute it properly. Bangladesh 9/2 after 3 overs.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Ferdous goes for a duck off the first ball of the over. Kamalini takes a nice catch on the offside. Ferdous goes for a drive but instead miscues it. Sobhana Mostary is the No.3. Bangladesh 8/1 after two overs.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: She often sets the tone. Dilara Akter and Juairiya Ferdous need to start well for Bangladesh to have any chance. First boundary for Dilara. Over mid-on. Off the fifth ball. Bangladesh 4/0 after the first over.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Single and she reaches her maiden T20I century off 49 balls. What an innings. She needed some help from Bharti Fulmali who took a single off the penultimate ball. Shafali hit three fours and nine sixes during her innings.
IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Just four runs off it and there is also the wicket of Richa Ghosh that India have lost. Marufa Akter has done a great job. India 185/4

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Rebiya Khan gets Harmanpreet Kaur for 40. Kaur played a nice hand for sure. She took 33 balls for her runs. More than that, she really guided Shafali Verma well. Easy stumping for Nigar Sultana. Richa Ghosh is next. India 181/3 after 18 overs.
IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Back-to-back sixes for her. One straight back, one over long off. Now she is into the nineties. 95 off 44 balls. India 175/2 after 17 overs. Nahida Akter concedes 16.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: They should score at least 200 from here. Shafali Verma has a good opportunity to score her first T20I century today. She deserves it. She has been just fantastic. 81 runs off just 40 balls.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Sultana at mid-off just let it go. It was an aerial shot from Harman. Sultana at least should have stopped it. Marufa Akter is furious, understandably so. One more boundary, this time from Shafali. Over mid-off. She follows it up with a massive six over deep midwicket. Excellent pull. Great over already for India. Wait, one more six. Over long-on. Plenty of power into that shot. India 150/ 2 after 15 overs. Shafali (102) has now hit maximum T20I sixes for aIndia.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Another sweep and another four. Off the first ball from Rebiya Khan, in the 14th over. Seems like Shafali Verma has been instructed to hang around. Not to be too adventurous. Not sure if that's the right thing to do. India 128/2 after 14 overs

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Via a nice sweep shot in the 12th over. It was her 11th ball. One more boundary for Harman. A nice cut on the offside. And just like that she is up and running. India 111/2 after 12 overs.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Harmanpreet is also struggling. India 101/2 after 11 overs. It appears Shafali is playing on a different pitch. Kamalini strugged too. 4 runs off nine balls for the Indian captain. Can she up the ante in the next few overs?

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: She does in style with a six. India 97/2 after 10 overs. She has taken 24 balls for her fifty. In the Asia Cup recently, she had hit three fifties and in the Asian Games opener against Japan she had scored 40 not out off just 15 balls. Purple patch for sure.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Goes for a sweep shot, finds a fielder at deep midwicket. She was really struggling. She made 3 off 10 balls. Can you believe it? Anyway, India Harmanpreet Kaur is next. India 86/2 after 9 overs. All of a sudden they have gone quiet. Kamalini fell in the the similar manner as she had against Japan, in a manner of speaking. Just that it was the long-on fielder.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: The momentum is of course broken with the Mandhana wicket. Gunalan Kamalini is the No.3 and naturally she will take some time to settle down. Just as we wrote that, Shafali picks up another six on the legside. India 85/1 after 8 overs.

IND-W vs BAN-W Live Score: Both batters look in great touch. Bangladesh in trouble for sure. Just as we said that, Smriti Mandhana goes back for 37. She went aerial on the legside and was caught in the deep. Nahida Akter provides the breakthrough for Bangladesh.
